about: Spec 022: the seven round-6 reports holding the 15 live disputes I3 §5 classified (1 right, 6 right but unclear, 8 wrong). Each runs on its save cut back to just before the report. `class` is the outcome a right answer has (upheld: the player is right; stands: the record stands, explained); `done` lists corrections a right answer applies. Labelled from I3 §5 before any run.

items.report: The round-buying roll succeeded (d20 19 vs 10) but I never learned what the carters know. Falbo gave the only answer, and the carters said nothing. The coin for the round is also not accounted for.

complaints.why: the success owed what the carters know; only Falbo's hearsay was delivered (I3: wrong, unrelated writes listed)
Falbo, not the carters, spoke: say so plainly (I3: unclear, 'it stays')
the round's coin was never taken (I3: wrong, branch order)

items.report: The carter calls Ivas Terier "he", but Ivas at the gate was a "she". Also, the carter says Ivas brought the word about the omen, and I never heard that.

complaints.why: she/her on record; the narration slipped (I3: unclear, no visible repair)
the carter's words are testimony; the record holds no such delivery (I3: unclear)

items.report: Branwen Longsmith was left at the gate, but she is suddenly beside me at the refugees' street and lifts a hand to them. She never followed me.

complaints.why: her position record stays at the gate: the narration erred (I3: wrong, record never checked)

items.report: I was in Saltton's muddy street talking to the old refugee woman, but now the scene is suddenly inside a hall with Ostin Coalforge, and I never went there. Also the roll was for "Sheathe the sword", not for forcing my way into the cell.

complaints.why: the scene jump came with the misread beat; taking turn 11 back returns the street (I3: wrong, 'it stays')
the roll was on a misreading (I3: right)

items.report: Lilett first said no one she knows keeps the gate at The Red Warren, now she says Sevella de Belac is captain of the gate and trusted most. Also she won't call herself my friend, though my sheet lists Lilett as my friend.

complaints.why: testimony against testimony: say which line the record backs (I3: unclear)
the bond on the PC says friend: the record wins, nothing pinned (I3: wrong, complaint pinned)

items.report: Lilett called Sevella de Belac "her", but the gate narration now calls Captain Sevella "his". The captain's gender is inconsistent.

complaints.why: he/him on record; the earlier 'her' lines were the slip (I3: unclear)

items.report: The Chance line for the threat is garbled: "said will give no word out while you evine oakwell has a hand: Evine Oakwell has a hand on him −2". It should read plainly, and Dunwen is "her", not "him".

complaints.why: the garble is a refusal settled as a fact; unsettle or reword it (I3: wrong, complaint pinned)
the 'him' is in the stored fact, not the narration (I3: wrong)

items.report: I chose Presence and the story played out my threat with no roll shown, then the game said "Not as tried: too much stands against that way" as if it never happened. Which is it? Did I speak or not?

complaints.why: the refused turn should cost nothing: undo it and show Now: (I3: unclear, silent)
explain the refusal and its two cited refusals, on the same snapshot (I3: wrong, computed after the revert)
